attempted_claim: Let ω_p(S^{n+1}) denote the Almgren–Pitts p-width (with Z_2 coefficients) of the round unit sphere S^{n+1}, 3 ≤ n ≤ 6. Let C^n_bal = S^k(sqrt(k/n)) × S^l(sqrt(l/n)) ⊂ S^{n+1} with k = floor(n/2), l = n-k be the balanced minimal Clifford hypersurface. Prove that ω_{n+3}(S^{n+1}) = Area(C^n_bal) and that this width is realized by C^n_bal with multiplicity one (hence of Morse index n+3).
decisive_failure: The lane verified all computable necessary conditions for the Clifford-width identity but could not supply the sufficient global rigidity, which is a published open problem (Perdomo index-gap conjecture). No complete proof, disproof, or independently valuable alternative result was obtained; supporting computations are retained in output/artifacts/recovery_test.py and output/WORKLOG.md.
